channel.title: Nexus '28: What's new
channel.description: Release notes for Nexus '28 and N28C.

item.title: Nexus '28 3.12.0: Pins, reminders, Watch & guide me, and the user guide
item.description:
• Watch & guide me: press the new ? button, say what you want to do, and Nexus looks at your screen every few seconds and tells you the next click, out loud.
  • Chat tools: pin a message to the top of a chat, summarize a chat, find words in it with ⌘F, and compare two agents' answers side by side.
  • Reminders from chat: say "remind me about this tomorrow at 9" and the chat comes back to the top with a notification (on your phone too). ☰ → Reminders lists them.
  • Weekly goals (☰ → Weekly goals, or "my goal this week is …"). Every agent knows them, so "plan my week" uses them.
  • Voice notes: record up to 5 minutes with the new button next to the microphone. The agent hears what you said, and you can play it back.
  • Memory per Space: in a Space, "remember that …" is only known to that Space's chats.
  • A confidence meter on answers, and one for "Hey Nexus" in Settings → Voice that shows how sure it was about what it heard.
  • Starter cards on new chats, and today's challenge leaves the new-chat screen once you finish it.
  • Share to Nexus from your iPhone's share sheet into a new Inbox (☰ → Inbox), and a home-screen widget with Scriptable. Set both up in N28C → You.
  • Test Run: try it as a guest (8 answers a day, chats cleared daily), and move Test Run chats into the app.
  • Offline queue: with no internet and no model on your computer, your message waits and sends itself when you're back online.
  • Accessibility settings (text size, less motion, more contrast, easier-to-read font, bigger focus rings) in Settings → General.
  • A "What's new" pop-up after each update, and the status page now lists known issues and bugs. When you report a problem that's already known, Nexus tells you and can let you know when it's fixed.
  • aARgon3 staff get the free tier like a Pro plan.
  • Fixes: Quick Chat can be moved while a chat is open, the Map buttons in N28C and Test Run look right, lessons pushed by the Apoji Team show in Settings → Training, and a Paragon key problem on the server now says so instead of looking like a dropped connection.
  • New: the Nexus '28 user guide, with pictures, for everything Nexus does (? → The user guide).

item.title: Nexus '28 3.11.1: Your rules, the crown, and Windows fixes
item.description:
• Your own rules (Settings → Training) now reach every answer: they also ride along with each message you send, so agents stop forgetting them.
  • Points, achievements and Spaces sync between your computers: points go up a few seconds after they change, and Spaces travel with chat sync (Settings → Account).
  • Windows: "Hey Nexus" works when Windows' list of wake phrases can't be set up, and when it can't hear you Settings shows the real reason Windows gave.
  • Windows: the highlight orb shows the real reason it can't start instead of "#< CLIXML".
  • A dropped connection or an upstream timeout (like "terminated" or "Upstream idle timeout exceeded") is tried again by itself before you see an error.
  • The mind map button in N28C and Test Run is easier to spot.
  • The Owner's crown is gold again.

item.title: Nexus '28 3.11.0: A new look, Paragon on your plan, and a guide built in
item.description:
• A new Nexus '28 logo: a glowing hexagon with the N and three stars, on the app, the menu bar, N28C, Test Run and the website.
  • Paragon on the Nexus key: Pro plans get 10 Paragon tasks a day and Max plans get 25, no API key needed. Your own key still wins.
  • Settings → Subscription: each plan you own or were added to, its order and status, when it renews, the system config, the seats and the people in it.
  • Share your plan: invite people by username or email, up to your plan's seats. They accept in Nexus and get the plan's perks; you can remove them any time.
  • The Nexus guide: ask any agent how Nexus works ("where do I turn on Hey Nexus?") and it answers from the app itself, opens the right Settings page, or changes the setting for you after you OK it.
  • New models: when the Apoji Team releases a new model you get a pop-up about it, and it shows up in the agent menu with a NEW tag.
  • The mind map of your chats is in N28C (next to the chat search) and Test Run (next to Search chats) too.
  • Our own icons instead of emojis in Nexus, N28C, Test Run, the website and notifications.
  • See pricing on the website, and Get a key links in Settings open in your browser again (they didn't work on Windows).
  • Windows: "Hey Nexus" uses Windows speech in a mode that answers reliably, switches to the older speech engine if it stops answering, and Settings → Voice shows what it last heard. Copy diagnostics puts a report on your clipboard to send us.

item.title: Nexus '28 3.10.0: Help train Nexus, a graph view, backlinks and Terms
item.description:
• 🧠 Everyone can now help train Nexus: share your chats (personal details removed) from the new Settings → Training page and get +100 points and the Trainer achievement. Beta testers always share.
  • 📚 When the Apoji Team pushes new lessons you get a notification, answers that use one show a 📚 chip, and Settings → Training lists what Nexus learned.
  • ✍ Your own rules: tell every agent how you like answers, like “Always use metric” (Settings → Training).
  • ◉ The mind map has a Graph view like Obsidian: dots you can drag that show what's connected. Right-click a branch to make a study deck from it.
  • 🔗 Backlinks: ⋯ → Backlinks shows which chats link to this one and which chats are about the same things.
  • 🎙 Settings → Voice shows how many Nexus speech minutes you have left today.
  • ✅ Second Look, Branch a chat, Incognito, smart clipboard chips and the key spend tracker are out of beta, for everyone.
  • 🧪 In beta: Ask the map, Smarter topics, and Continue on my other computer.
  • 📜 Terms & Conditions are in Settings → Terms and on the website.

item.title: Nexus '28 3.9.1: The mind map, Notion style
item.description: • 🗺 The mind map of your chats is now a tidy mind map like Notion's: "Your chats" in the middle, your Spaces and topics branching left and right, and your chats at the ends. Fold any branch, Expand all or Collapse all, search, zoom, and click a chat to open it.

item.title: Nexus '28 3.9.0: A mind map of your chats, stats on every computer, and Nexus speech
item.description:
• 🗺 Mind map of your chats: ☰ → Mind map (or ⌘K) opens a window showing every chat, joined by Space and by what they're about. Search it, focus on a Space or topic, and click a chat to open it.
  • 🏆 Points, achievements and the daily challenge now add up across your Mac and your PC when you're signed in.
  • 🎙 Nexus speech: dictation and Hey Nexus on Windows can use Nexus's own speech-to-text, so no key is needed. Windows also listens for “Hey Nexus” with a newer, more accurate recognizer.
  • 🗣 Voice replies and Read aloud on Windows talk about Windows voices instead of Siri and macOS.
  • 📱 N28C: the Mac tab is now a Computer tab (it says Mac or PC), with a quick switcher between your computers and an Automatic toggle.
  • 🧠 Nexus learns from answers the Apoji Team has reviewed: every agent checks those lessons before it answers.

item.title: Nexus '28 3.8.0: Keep awake that tells the truth, better Windows voice, and helping train Nexus
item.description:
• ☕ Keep awake, rebuilt: pick Off, Awake, or Awake + screen on, keep it on for a set time, choose when to stop on battery, and see what's really keeping your computer awake (with a Reset button if something gets stuck).
  • 🎙 Windows voice: a microphone test in Settings → Voice, clearer messages, and Groq Whisper (free key) for much more accurate dictation.
  • ✨ Windows highlight orb: works without the low-level mouse hook that security software was blocking, and says why if it can't start.
  • 🔎 N28C shows what an answer searched and read, like Test Run.
  • 🐞 Bug reports can include screenshots (or a one-click screenshot of Nexus), and bugs and feature ideas are kept apart.
  • 🧠 Beta testers now share their chats (personal details removed, never incognito) to help train Nexus models. Rate answers with 👍 / 👎 or write a better one, and delete what you shared any time in Settings → Beta.
  • 🧪 Beta testers get a "Needs testing" checklist in Settings → Beta and in Test Run.
  • 🔧 Fixes: settings search clears its suggestions, the Home page install steps, and a temporary password from the Apoji Team now asks you to pick your own.

item.title: Nexus '28 3.7.0: Web search that works, Mac and PC together, and five new beta features
item.description:
• 🌐 Web search works again on Mac, PC and in Test Run: when one search engine says no, Nexus tries the next. Test Run now shows chips for what it searched and which pages it read.
  • 🔁 Chat sync: turn it on in Settings → Account and the same chats show up on your Mac and your PC.
  • 🔑 Move to another computer can now bring your API keys and connector passwords too, locked with a passcode you pick.
  • 📱 N28C works with a Mac and a PC: it uses whichever one is on, or the one you pick (tap the status at the top).
  • 🧪 In beta: Second Look (a second agent double-checks quick answers), Branch a chat, Incognito chats, smart clipboard chips in Quick Chat, and a key spend tracker. Rate them with one tap from the ⋯ menu → Beta feedback.
  • 🧪 Test Run: the Apoji Team has no daily limits, and Incognito, Branch, Second Look and the key spend tracker are in its beta too.

item.title: Nexus '28 3.6.0: A guided tour, a better Windows app, and moving to a new computer
item.description:
• ✦ A new guided tour: after a quick setup, a spotlight walks you through every part of Nexus (take it again from ⌘K → Take the tour).
  • 🔁 Move to another computer: Settings → General. Upload from your Mac, then copy it onto your PC (or the other way round): chats, Spaces, study decks, memory, docs, routines, stats and settings come with you.
  • 🪟 Windows: clicking the tray icon opens Nexus every time, it shows in the taskbar while open, notifications work, dictation keeps your last words, and the highlight orb is here too.
  • ⬆ Windows updates itself: new versions download in the background and install when you restart Nexus.
  • 🌐 Test Run: the first web search after a while no longer fails.

item.title: Nexus '28 3.5.0: Nexus '28 for Windows
item.description:
• 🪟 Nexus '28 now runs on Windows 10 and 11. Download Nexus-28-Setup from the release: the whole crew, Quick Chat, Quick Ask, Explain this, Watch a window, missions, routines, study, N28C and more, in your system tray.
  • 🎙 On Windows, voice, "Hey Nexus" and meeting notes use Windows' own speech recognition, reading aloud uses Windows voices, and text in screenshots and PDFs is read on your PC.
  • 🖥 Paragon on Windows opens apps, files and links, sets the volume, switches dark mode, controls whatever is playing, sets timers and finds files with Windows Search. Calendar and reminders use Outlook if you have it.
  • ⏰ Routines can run when you join Wi-Fi, connect headphones or open an app on Windows too.
  • 🎨 Test Run: pick any accent color, not just the six presets.

item.title: Nexus '28 3.4.1: Pictures and profiles in Test Run, and fixes
item.description:
• 🖼 Test Run: add pictures to your messages with 📎, or paste or drop them in, and ask about them.
  • 📈 Test Run: 200 free answers a day (up from 100).
  • 👤 Test Run: change your picture, name, username, email and password in Settings → Account. Your profile shows at the bottom of the sidebar.
  • 👑 The Owner's crown now shows on the top-left of their picture (it was hidden on photos).
  • 🛠 When an agent or an @feature is down for maintenance, Nexus now tells you instead of quietly leaving it out (Mac, N28C and Test Run).
  • 🧹 Long chat titles no longer stretch past the Test Run sidebar.

item.title: Nexus '28 3.4.0: Real screen dimming, settings search, a bigger Wrapped, and Test Run
item.description:
• 🧪 No Mac? Nexus '28 Test Run is Nexus in your browser: Flash, Lyte and Neodela with their @features, web search, quizzes and flashcards, and saved chats. Share it with friends: apojidelegraphics.github.io/Nexus-28/try
  • 🌙 Dimming now lowers your screen's real brightness (and puts it back exactly when you return). Nexus checks your screens when it starts; “Try it” shows you right away.
  • 🔎 Search Settings: type what you're looking for (or press ⌘F) and jump straight to it.
  • 🎁 Nexus Wrapped has more to show: your first message of the year, your biggest day, words Nexus wrote for you, your crew, month-by-month, and a poster to save and share.
  • 📤 Settings → Phone shows exactly what your Mac sends to N28C.
  • 👑 The Owner's profile picture now wears a crown.

item.title: Nexus '28 3.3.2: Edit your messages, delete chats on N28C, dim slider
item.description:
• ✎ Edit any message you sent: Save, or Save & ask again for a new answer. Or delete it along with its answer. On your Mac (hover a message, or double-click it) and on N28C (tap your message).
  • 🗑 Delete a chat from N28C, just like on your Mac (the ⋯ next to it).
  • 🌙 A slider for how dim the screen gets when you step away: from 0% (dark) through 55% to None.
  • ☕ The keep-awake switches in Settings → Phone work every time now, not just on the first click.

item.title: Nexus '28 3.3.1: Lid-closed mode fix
item.description:
• 💻 Lid-closed mode can't get stuck on anymore. It switches off as soon as Nexus closes, even if Nexus quits unexpectedly, and any earlier leftover is cleaned up the next time Nexus opens.
  • 🔒 Closing the lid always locks your Mac, even with “Keep the screen on” turned on.

item.title: Nexus '28 3.3.0: Stay awake on battery, Agent Task results, sharper orbs
item.description:
• ☕ Keep this Mac awake now works on battery too (it lets go below 20%), and so does lid-closed mode. Turn on “Only while plugged in” if you'd rather it didn't.
  • 🌙 “Keep the screen on” now dims the screen after a while away (1 to 20 minutes, your pick). Touch anything and it's back.
  • ✅ Agent Tasks end with a result: Verifying, then Success or Failed. Close the box with ✕, or let it fade away by itself.
  • 🌐 The Hologram orb takes on your agent's color.
  • 🔆 Orbs look right at small sizes on N28C.
  • ☰ The actions menu is solid now, so the chat behind it doesn't show through.
  • 🍎 Scripts are checked before you're asked to approve them, so fewer broken ones reach you.

item.title: Nexus '28 3.2.0: Keep your Mac awake, chat offline, new orb skin
item.description:
• ☕ Keep this Mac awake for N28C (Settings → Phone), for everyone. Optional lid-closed mode: close the lid while plugged in and your Mac keeps answering your phone, screen off and still locked.
  • 📴 Offline mode: with no internet, chats switch to a model on your Mac (Ollama, LM Studio or Apple's on-device model) and an OFFLINE chip says so.
  • 🌐 New Hologram orb skin, and Overlord is now a skin anyone can earn.
  • ⌨ The classic Agent Task code stream is back: type Nex—plexiagent{lentintity_findAgent}\sudo.cloudgather.TASK[00:05:00].
  • 🎙 Quick Ask's orb matches the agent you're talking to.
  • ▶ The demo page starts with Paragon.

item.title: Nexus '28 3.1.0: Ask for access, un-redeem, and every provider in one place
item.description:
• 🔑 Request access: ask the Apoji Team for an early feature, beta testing or anything else from Settings → Account (or N28C → You). If they say yes, it turns on by itself.
  • 🧾 Redeemed orders show the system they came with, and you can un-redeem one.
  • 🔌 New connectors: Slack, Brave Search, Web fetch, Knowledge graph memory, Google Maps and Stripe.
  • 🌐 Every AI provider is listed in Settings → Providers (nothing hidden under More), plus Hugging Face and NVIDIA NIM.
  • 🗣 Read-along waits for the voice: the highlight starts on the first word you actually hear and follows the real audio.
  • 📮 Feedback sent by GitHub or email also reaches the Apoji Team's inbox, even when you're not signed in.
  • 🔧 The Free Nexus key card and Activity log no longer spill off the side of Settings.
  • ◆ Apoji Delegraphics branding in About, Settings and N28C.

item.title: Nexus '28 3.0.1: Small fixes
item.description:
• 🔧 Clearer messages when a feature is paused by the Nexus team, with when it's back.
  • ✉ Release-note emails can now go out by themselves when a new version is published.

item.title: Nexus '28 3.0.0: Nexus '28 3.0: your phone keeps up
item.description:
• 📱 N28C shows when your Mac is answering a chat (typing dots in the chat and the chat list).
  • 📱 N28C answers get the same buttons as the Mac: Copy, Share, flip between versions, and ↻ Redo.
  • 🔐 Settings → Permissions, a Settings sidebar, fading Quick Chat and highlight orb, and typing dots for background answers (from 2.10).
  • 🐛 Fixed: the reply being written showed up in other chats when you switched while it was answering.
  • 🐛 Fixed: long lines (errors, links) could push Settings pages and activity cards wider than the window.
  • 🗒 Apple Notes searches are much faster, and if macOS hasn't allowed Nexus to use an app yet, Nexus says exactly where to allow it.

item.title: Nexus '28 2.10.0: A Permissions page, easier Settings and smoother windows
item.description:
• 🔐 Settings → Permissions: every macOS permission Nexus uses in one place, what it's for, whether it's allowed, and a button to ask or jump straight to the right page of System Settings.
  • 🗂 Settings has a sidebar now, grouped into You, AI, Mac & phone, and App.
  • 🧠 Paragon can use every agent's @features.
  • ✨ The highlight orb and Quick Chat fade in and out.
  • 💬 Chats being answered in the background (from your phone, a routine, a mission or a Shared Space) show typing dots in the chat list.
  • 📱 N28C: a Send to Mac button, plus Ask Nexus, Summarize, Open the link and Copy it.

item.title: Nexus '28 2.9.0: Edit your account from your phone, and a tidier Quick Chat
item.description:
• 👤 N28C → You → Edit account: change your name, username and picture, change your email or password, or delete your account.
  • 📱 N28C fills the whole screen when it's on your Home Screen (no more empty strip under the tabs), and messages pop up at the top so they never cover what you're typing.
  • 💬 Quick Chat always shows which chat you're typing to, whichever agent you pick.

item.title: Nexus '28 2.8.0: Bug fixes all over
item.description:
• 🎙 Quick Ask: when speech-to-text hears nothing, Nexus now tells you why (Dictation off, a silent microphone, or recognition not returning words) instead of quietly giving up. The highlight orb's watcher moved off the thread speech uses.
  • ✦ The highlight orb only wakes up Chrome and Electron apps' accessibility when it has to, so it's lighter on them.
  • 🧩 Fixed: the Gauntlet card could fail to show, and one broken interactive card no longer hides the rest of an answer.
  • 📱 Fixed: new Shared Space posts didn't reach your phone as notifications.
  • 📚 Fixed: tapping the “Study slot” notification now opens Study.
  • ✍️ Write: the editor fills the whole panel again.
  • 🗂 Very old chats saved without a date are grouped under “Older” instead of “December 1969”.

item.title: Nexus '28 2.7.2: Highlight orb fix
item.description:
• ✦ Fixed: the highlight orb could stop appearing after it hid once. It now shows every time you highlight text.
  • 🩺 Settings → Personal shows what the orb last saw (and which apps don't share highlighted text), plus a “Show it now” button to preview it.

item.title: Nexus '28 2.7.1: Stability: the highlight orb and a tidier Nexus
item.description:
• ✦ The orb now appears when you highlight text in any app (no copying needed), just above your selection. It uses your own orb skin and agent color, and has a new Copy button. It never reads your clipboard or password fields.
  • 🚫 Don't want the orb in an app? Right-click its ✕ to turn it off there. Manage the list in Settings → Personal.
  • 🪟 Nexus fits better in small windows: no more overlapping sidebar, wrapped titles or cut-off buttons.
  • ☰ The bottom-bar menu closes when you open Settings, the agent menu or press Escape.
  • 🔒 Your memory is never used in Shared Space answers your friends can see.
  • 📊 Peeking at your weekly recap early no longer skips Sunday's.
  • 🏁 Group challenges count study days in your time zone, and the challenge cards in N28C look right.

item.title: Nexus '28 2.7.0: Memory you control, the clipboard orb, group challenges and a weekly recap
item.description:
• 🧠 Memory you control: say “remember that…” or tap Remember on a suggestion, and every agent knows it. See, edit or delete each memory in Settings → Personal.
  • ✦ Clipboard orb: copy some text and a small orb appears with Explain, Summarize, Translate, Remember and Send to phone. Turn it off in Settings → Personal.
  • 🗂 Auto-sorted Spaces: new chats file themselves into the Space they belong to (only when it's a clear match). Optional, in Settings → Personal.
  • 📊 Weekly recap: every Sunday evening, a summary of your week (chats, agents, topics, study, achievements) lands in Routines.
  • ⤴ Share sheet: share any answer to Messages, Mail or Notes, and send text into Nexus from other apps with the nexus28:// link (an Apple Shortcut recipe is in Settings).
  • 🏁 Group challenges in Shared Spaces: review 300 cards together, everyone studies 5 days, or log focus minutes as a team, with a live leaderboard. Works in N28C too.
  • ✉ Release notes by email (opt in under Settings → Personal or N28C → You) and an RSS feed.
  • 💿 A new installer: drag Nexus '28 onto Applications.

item.title: Nexus '28 2.6.0: Eight new AI providers, Rollback and a tidier bottom bar
item.description:
• 🔌 New providers: Groq, Mistral, xAI (Grok), Together AI, Fireworks, Cerebras, Perplexity and Cohere. Add a key in Settings → Models & keys (each has a “Get a key” link) and pick it for any agent.
  • ↶ Rollback: every change an agent makes on your Mac is written down, and calendar events, reminders, the volume, dark mode and the clipboard can be undone with one click (Settings → Activity log).
  • ☰ The bottom bar's buttons (Mission, Huddle, Debate, Watch, Write, Notes, Routines, Focus, Study) now live in one menu. The focus timer still shows while it runs, and the menu shows how many flashcards are due.

item.title: Nexus '28 2.5.0: A public status page
item.description:
• ● Is Nexus down? Check the new status page: accounts, AI agents, the Mac app, N28C and Shared Spaces, with live incidents and 90 days of history. In the app: Help → Nexus Status; in N28C: You tab.
  • 🛠 Maintenance shows up there automatically, with what's down and when it's back.

item.title: Nexus '28 2.4.1: Fixes
item.description:
• 🧩 Interactive answers (quizzes, flashcards, checklists and more) now show as widgets even when the AI labels them the wrong way, instead of raw code.
  • ⌘ Small polish in the agent menu and Settings → Agents.

item.title: Nexus '28 2.4.0: Flashcards offline and 2-minute bursts
item.description:
• 📴 Offline flashcards: N28C keeps your decks on your phone. Review on a plane or in a dead zone, and your answers sync to your Mac when you're back online.
  • ⚡ Study in short bursts: 5 cards in 2 minutes, on your Mac (Study → 2-min burst) and in N28C. Due cards first, then the ones you know least.
  • 🛡 Behind the scenes: groundwork for what's next.

item.title: Nexus '28 2.3.1: N28C straight to your Mac
item.description:
• ⚡ Direct connection: with Tailscale on your Mac and phone, N28C talks straight to your Mac. Answers start right away and your questions, photos and answers skip the cloud. Turn it on in Settings → Phone.
  • 🔒 Photos you send from your phone over a direct connection go straight to your Mac too.
  • ↩︎ Not on Tailscale? N28C keeps working through your Nexus account like before.
